stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Atlas must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Atlas must not be in position 1.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Atlas and Chronicle must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 4 such orders. "Atlas and Chronicle must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Ballad → Epic
- Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Epic → Ballad
- Atlas → Epic → Chronicle → Ballad → Diary
- Atlas → Epic → Chronicle → Diary → Ballad

distractorRationale.b: Even with the additional condition, Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Ballad → Epic is permitted and makes this statement false.
distractorRationale.c: Even with the additional condition, Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Ballad → Epic is permitted and makes this statement false.
distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Ballad → Epic is permitted and makes this statement false.
